agh-openclash.description: Keep AdGuard Home as DNS owner while OpenClash handles routing.

recommendation.reason: AdGuard Home is the active DNS backend.
recommendation.risk: Enabling dnsmasq or a DNS kill-switch can steal DNS ownership from AdGuard Home.

agh-openclash.title: AdGuard Home + OpenClash

dns-kill-switch-off.description: Do not intercept DNS with a firewall kill-switch when AdGuard Home owns DNS.

recommendation.reason: AdGuard Home already owns DNS; a DNS kill-switch would fight that topology.
recommendation.risk: Blocking port 53 can break the active DNS backend instead of protecting routing.

dns-kill-switch-off.title: DNS kill-switch disabled

failclosed-strict.description: Keep the global kill switch on so protected traffic cannot fall to DIRECT.

recommendation.reason: OpenClash is installed; fail-closed kill switch should stay enabled.
recommendation.risk: If OpenClash stops, unprotected forwarding can leak protected sessions.

failclosed-strict.title: Strict fail-closed guard

gaming-safe.description: Use scoped gaming bypass without allowing QUIC leakage.

recommendation.reason: Gaming client detected; blanket UDP bypass is unsafe.
recommendation.risk: UDP/443 may carry HTTP/3/QUIC and a source-only bypass can escape service routing.

gaming-safe.title: Safe Gaming UDP
